article.story: High Point Panthers vs. Liberty Flames Rock Hill, South Carolina; Monday, 12 a.m. EST LINE: Panthers -7.5; over/under is 155.5 BOTTOM LINE: Liberty takes on High Point in Rock Hill, South Carolina. Liberty went 26-8 overall with a 12-5 record in non-conference games in the 2025-26 season. The Flames shot 51.0% from the field and 39.3% from 3-point range last season. High Point finished 31-5 overall with a 13-4 record in non-conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Panthers averaged 10.6 steals, 3.8 blocks and 9.0 turnovers per game last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
